title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #13

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. You find a Ksh 100 note in the classroom. What is the right choice? (1 mark)
   A. Keep it quietly
   B. Give it to the teacher to find the owner
   C. Hide it
   D. Spend it at the school shop

2. What should you do first when you must make a difficult choice? (1 mark)
   A. Ask nobody
   B. Stop and think
   C. Do what your friends do
   D. Choose quickly without thinking

3. Which Old Testament chapter tells the sad story of Tamar? (1 mark)
   A. Psalm 23
   B. Exodus 20
   C. 2 Samuel 13
   D. Genesis 12

4. Which of these shows God's love? (1 mark)
   A. He punishes for no reason
   B. He hides from people
   C. He ignores prayers
   D. He gave us Jesus to save us

5. Which book comes directly after Genesis? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus
   B. Numbers
   C. Joshua
   D. Leviticus

6. How many books are in the Old Testament? (1 mark)
   A. 39
   B. 66
   C. 12
   D. 27

7. How did the crowd react when Jesus went to Zacchaeus' house? (1 mark)
   A. They cheered
   B. They were silent
   C. They grumbled
   D. They followed Zacchaeus

8. What does it mean to acknowledge God's power? (1 mark)
   A. To ignore God
   B. To hide our talents
   C. To boast about ourselves
   D. To admit that our strength comes from Him and thank Him

9. What did Joseph advise Pharaoh to store during the good years? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. All the harvest
   C. One fifth of the harvest
   D. Half the animals

10. What did God tell Abram to do? (1 mark)
   A. Build a boat
   B. Leave his country and go to a land God would show him
   C. Stay at home
   D. Go to Egypt

11. To whom was Mary engaged to be married? (1 mark)
   A. David
   B. Joseph
   C. Zechariah
   D. Simeon

12. Which is a kind way to help a blind person? (1 mark)
   A. Laugh at them
   B. Leave them out
   C. Greet them by name and offer to guide them
   D. Move their things

13. What is a widow? (1 mark)
   A. A woman without children
   B. A woman whose husband has died
   C. A queen
   D. A teacher

14. Why did Jesus tell the parables in Luke 15? (1 mark)
   A. Some leaders complained that He welcomed sinners
   B. To praise money
   C. To teach farming
   D. To entertain

15. What does the woman's search teach us about money? (1 mark)
   A. Money is valuable and should be looked after
   B. Money is unimportant
   C. Hide it always
   D. Lose it quickly

16. What does the seed grow into? (1 mark)
   A. A small flower
   B. A rock
   C. A river
   D. A large tree

17. How many people were baptised on the day of Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. About three
   B. About thirty
   C. About three thousand
   D. About three hundred

18. What does repentance do? (1 mark)
   A. It pushes us away from God
   B. It draws us close to Christ
   C. It makes us proud
   D. It has no effect

19. What group did Nicodemus belong to? (1 mark)
   A. The disciples
   B. The Pharisees
   C. The shepherds
   D. The Romans

20. Which helpline can children in Kenya call for help? (1 mark)
   A. 555
   B. 10
   C. 900
   D. 116

21. Which of these is dishonest? (1 mark)
   A. Copying in a test
   B. Returning lost money
   C. Admitting a mistake
   D. Saying sorry

22. Who does the Bible say we should be like in holiness? (1 mark)
   A. Our friends
   B. The king
   C. God
   D. Our teachers

23. Which action honours God with the body? (1 mark)
   A. Using bad words
   B. Keeping clean and eating well
   C. Taking drugs
   D. Fighting

24. What did Stephen see before he died? (1 mark)
   A. Heaven open and Jesus standing at God's right hand
   B. A lion
   C. A storm
   D. Nothing

25. What does the word Christian mean? (1 mark)
   A. A rich person
   B. A priest
   C. A soldier
   D. A follower of Christ

26. What do we ask when we say "forgive us our debts"? (1 mark)
   A. Money
   B. A gift
   C. Forgiveness of our sins
   D. Bread

27. Which fruit is shown by making peace between quarrelling friends? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Greed
   C. Peace
   D. Laziness

28. What does defile mean? (1 mark)
   A. To clean
   B. To help
   C. To praise
   D. To make unclean or harm

29. Which decision step comes first? (1 mark)
   A. Choose quickly
   B. Stop and think
   C. Ask nobody
   D. Copy others

30. Which of these is personal information to protect? (1 mark)
   A. The weather
   B. Your home address
   C. The colour of the sky
   D. A favourite song

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Name the three places in the journey of Abram, in order. (2 marks)

32. Explain what Psalm 119:105 teaches about how the Bible helps us to make right choices. (4 marks)

33. Give two reasons why Zacchaeus climbed the sycamore-fig tree. (2 marks)

34. Explain how John the Baptist prepared the way for Jesus and what we can learn about living righteously. (5 marks)

35. Explain what the story teaches about gratitude and give one example from school life. (4 marks)

36. Give three ways in which God helps us today. (3 marks)

37. Explain the steps a child can take to turn away from wrong behaviour, using Zacchaeus as an example. (5 marks)

38. Explain what it means to say that love is a choice. (4 marks)

39. State three ways in which the first Christians lived together. (3 marks)

40. Explain why young people should lead holy lives, and give four ways of doing it. (5 marks)

41. Give two forms of dishonesty other than lying. (2 marks)

42. Explain four ways of showing responsibility at school. (4 marks)

43. Describe three steps for making a right decision. (3 marks)

44. List two attributes of God. (2 marks)

45. Name two digital devices used at home or school. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Give it to the teacher to find the owner
   Honesty means returning what is not ours.

2. B — Stop and think
   Thinking first helps us to choose well.

3. C — 2 Samuel 13
   The story of Tamar is in 2 Samuel 13.

4. D — He gave us Jesus to save us
   John 3:16 shows God's love in giving His Son.

5. A — Exodus
   The order is Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy.

6. A — 39
   The Old Testament has 39 books.

7. C — They grumbled
   Luke 19:7 says they all began to mutter.

8. D — To admit that our strength comes from Him and thank Him
   Acknowledging means to accept and thank.

9. C — One fifth of the harvest
   Genesis 41:34 says to take a fifth.

10. B — Leave his country and go to a land God would show him
   Genesis 12:1 records the call.

11. B — Joseph
   Mary was engaged to Joseph of the house of David.

12. C — Greet them by name and offer to guide them
   Kindness and respect help people with disabilities.

13. B — A woman whose husband has died
   A widow has lost her husband.

14. A — Some leaders complained that He welcomed sinners
   Jesus showed God's love for sinners.

15. A — Money is valuable and should be looked after
   The woman valued her coin.

16. D — A large tree
   The seed grew and became a tree.

17. C — About three thousand
   Acts 2:41 says about three thousand.

18. B — It draws us close to Christ
   Repenting means turning to God for a new start.

19. B — The Pharisees
   He was a Pharisee.

20. D — 116
   Childline Kenya's number is 116.

21. A — Copying in a test
   Copying is cheating.

22. C — God
   1 Peter 1:16 says to be holy because God is holy.

23. B — Keeping clean and eating well
   Care for the body honours God.

24. A — Heaven open and Jesus standing at God's right hand
   Acts 7:55-56.

25. D — A follower of Christ
   Christian means a follower of Christ.

26. C — Forgiveness of our sins
   Debts stands for sins.

27. C — Peace
   Peace is a fruit.

28. D — To make unclean or harm
   Defile means to harm or make unclean.

29. B — Stop and think
   Stopping helps you decide well.

30. B — Your home address
   Never share your address online.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ur, Haran, Canaan.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct places and 1 mark for the correct order.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: A lamp lights the path so that we can see where to step. The Bible shows us what is right and wrong so that we can choose safely. It guides us in the dark, that is, when we are confused.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the lamp picture, 1 for guidance to right and wrong, 1 for use when confused, 1 for a clear link to choices.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: He was short, the crowd was big, and he wanted to see Jesus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

34. (5 marks)
   Answer: John preached in the wilderness, called people to repent and baptised them, so their hearts were ready for Jesus. We can learn to turn away from sin, be honest and kind, pray, and tell others about Jesus by our example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for preaching, 1 for repentance, 1 for baptism or readiness, 1 for turning from sin, 1 for a righteous example.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: Jesus noticed that only one of the ten returned to thank Him. We should be thankful to God and to people. Example: thanking a teacher who helped with a difficult lesson.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the lesson, 1 for Jesus noticing, 1 for a school example, 1 for explanation of gratitude.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: He gives courage, wisdom, the power to forgive, healing and protection, and talents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

37. (5 marks)
   Answer: Admit the wrong; be sorry and tell God; say sorry to the person hurt; put things right as Zacchaeus repaid; decide not to repeat and ask God for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, and a clear link to Zacchaeus.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: We do not always feel like loving. We can still choose to be kind, like helping someone who annoyed us. Love shows in actions.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not always feeling, 1 for choosing kindness, 1 for example, 1 for actions.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: They learned the teaching, prayed, ate together, shared with the needy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

40. (5 marks)
   Answer: God is holy and asks us to be holy. Our bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit. A holy life keeps us safe and pleases God. Ways: keep clean, avoid drugs and alcohol, choose good friends, avoid harmful media, pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's call, 1 for the temple idea, 1 for safety, 2 for ways.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Cheating, blaming others, exaggerating, gossiping, breaking promises.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep the class clean, take care of books, obey rules, do assigned duties, return borrowed things.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way up to 4.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stop and think, ask if it pleases God, pray, ask advice, choose the right thing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Sole Creator, loving Father, holy. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each attribute.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Phone, tablet, computer, TV, radio.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
